name: jcyw_spider_8x10
source: owner read the unit's printed 15-channel chart 2026-10-12 (same layout as QLC+ U`King ZQ-B20 Mini Spider); LED colours checked one by one on the unit: LED1-4 = R,G,B,W (LED1 bottom, stage left), LED5-8 = R,G,B,W (LED5 top, stage right).
notes: Menu SLnd must be SL 1 (DMX). No pan channel under DMX; two bars tilt 120 deg each (ch1/ch2). Each LED has its own dimmer and a fixed colour, so colours are chosen by which LEDs are lit.

tilt1.notes: Y1 runs opposite to the model's sense (owner, 2026-10-12: bars pointed out when the model said in)

tilt2.notes: Y2 mirrored vs Y1 on the unit; with Y1 inverted, Y2 needs no flag (owner checked in/out on 2026-10-12)

effect.notes: 0-7 no effect, higher = built-in effects; keep 0

optics.notes: per 10 W LED cell; two parallel bars side by side, each tilting about its long axis; bar 2 is the mirrored twin (LED5 at the opposite end from LED1)
